params.body:
Every switch in the Beveiliging section is a POST followed by a redirect, so the page comes back fresh and the visitor is at the top again. Pressing "Instellen" meant scrolling down a long profile page to see what had happened, and the password question it sends you to sits halfway down that same page.

The section now finds itself when the page arrives after such an action. Not a fragment in the URL: most of those redirects come from Fortify and carry none, so the page reads the session instead (`confirm_first`, or a status the section knows) and hands the browser one instruction. A plain visit jumps nowhere, and that is pinned too, because a page that scrolls on arrival is its own kind of annoying.

New rule R P2-3.21; `bin/rules-sources --write` set its stand.
params.title: The security section keeps its place
